definitionZh: Contrast描述了字体的粗细部分之间的中风宽度差. 数值为0表示没有可见/明显对比. 一个正数表明,相对于通过使细中风变薄而实现的零相位厚度而言,相对增高. 值为100表示细中风已完全消失. 一个负值表示"反向对比":在写作系统中通常会厚的划线反而变薄. 在西语字体中,这可能被认为是19世纪的一种"circus"或"old West"效应. 数值为 -100 表示通常厚的中风已完全消失。
sourceDefinition: Contrast describes the stroke width difference between the thick and thin parts of the font glyphs. A value of zero indicates no visible/apparent contrast. A positive number indicates an increase in contrast relative to the zero-contrast thickness, achieved by making the thin stroke thinner. A value of 100 indicates that the thin stroke has disappeared completely. A negative value indicates "reverse contrast": the strokes which would conventionally be thick in the writing system are instead made thinner. In western-language fonts this might be perceived as a 19th-century, "circus" or "old West" effect. A value of -100 indicates that the strokes which would normally be thick have disappeared completely.
